          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "async (req, res, next) =\u003e {"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48,
            "text": "const ["
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49,
            "text": "      byTypeResult,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50,
            "text": "      byCentreResult,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51,
            "text": "      byClinicianResult,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52,
            "text": "      slowResult,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53,
            "text": "    ] = await "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 110,
            "text": "      // Q3: per-clinician capability matrix"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 111,
            "text": "      bindAll(pool.request()).query(&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 112,
            "text": "        SELECT"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 113,
            "text": "          au.Id          AS clinicianId,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 114,
            "text": "          au.FirstName   AS firstName,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 115,
            "text": "          au.LastName    AS lastName,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 116,
            "text": "          MAX(c.CentreName) AS centreName,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 117,
            "text": "          SUM(CASE WHEN ap.Assessment = 'SPM'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                       AS SPM_assigned,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 118,
            "text": "          SUM(CASE WHEN ap.Assessment = 'SPM'   AND ap.IsResultGenerate = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SPM_completed,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 119,
            "text": "          SUM(CASE WHEN ap.Assessment = 'DP3'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                       AS DP3_assigned,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 120,
            "text": "          SUM(CASE WHEN ap.Assessment = 'DP3'   AND ap.IsResultGenerate = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DP3_completed,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 121,
            "text": "          SUM(CASE WHEN ap.Assessment = 'REELS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                       AS REELS_assigned,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 122,
            "text": "          SUM(CASE WHEN ap.Assessment = 'REELS' AND ap.IsResultGenerate = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REELS_completed,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 123,
            "text": "          SUM(CASE WHEN ap.Assessment = 'ISAA'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                       AS ISAA_assigned,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 124,
            "text": "          SUM(CASE WHEN ap.Assessment = 'ISAA'  AND ap.IsResultGenerate = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ISAA_completed"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 125,
            "text": "        FROM AllocatePatient ap"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 126,
            "text": "        JOIN AdminUser au  ON au.Id  = ap.ClinicianUserId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 127,
            "text": "        JOIN Patient pt    ON pt.Id  = ap.PatientId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 128,
            "text": "        JOIN Centre c      ON c.Id   = pt.CentreId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 129,
            "text": "        WHERE ap.Assessment IN ('SPM','DP3','REELS','ISAA')"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 130,
            "text": "          AND ${centreFilter}"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 131,
            "text": "          AND ${centreExclusion}"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 132,
            "text": "          AND ${dateFilter}"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 133,
            "text": "          AND LOWER(au.FirstName) NOT LIKE '%test%'"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 134,
            "text": "          AND LOWER(au.LastName)  NOT LIKE '%test%'"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 135,
            "text": "          AND LOWER(au.Email)     NOT LIKE '%@webority.com'"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 136,
            "text": "        GROUP BY au.Id, au.FirstName, au.LastName"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 137,
            "text": "        ORDER BY au.LastName, au.FirstName"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 138,
            "text": "      &#96;),"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 140,
            "text": "      // Q4: slow / overdue assessments — pending more than 14 days"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 141,
            "text": "      bindAll(pool.request()).query"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 160
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 161,
            "text": ";"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 243,
            "text": "}"
          }

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "# Unity Data Guide"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": "\u003e **Who this is for:** Ops, centre managers, and leadership using the Unity Dashboard  "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4,
            "text": "\u003e **Last updated:** May 2026"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6,
            "text": "This guide explains the **data behind the dashboard** — not the full Unity database. It covers the tables, events, and statuses that drive your KPIs, bottlenecks, and user profiles."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10,
            "text": "## The workflow in one picture"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "Every child case moves through the same pipeline. The dashboard tracks each step:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "Centre Admin registers child"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "        ↓"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "Manager assigns assessment to clinician"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "        ↓"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19,
            "text": "Clinician completes assessment → result generated"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "        ↓"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21,
            "text": "(Optional) Clinician submits goals → Manager approves"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24,
            "text": "Each arrow is recorded as an **activity event** in the system. That is what the dashboard counts."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28,
            "text": "## 7 tables that matter"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30,
            "text": "### 1. Centre — Therapy locations"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32,
            "text": "Where children receive services. Used for centre filters and per-centre breakdowns."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34,
            "text": "| Field | What it means |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35,
            "text": "|-------|---------------|"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36,
            "text": "| Centre Name | Name shown in the dashboard |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37,
            "text": "| Status | Whether the centre is active |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38,
            "text": "| Address / Pin Code | Location details |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40,
            "text": "*Test and deleted centres are excluded from dashboard metrics.*"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44,
            "text": "### 2. Patient — Children"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46,
            "text": "Each row is one child enrolled in the programme."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48,
            "text": "| Field | What it means |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49,
            "text": "|-------|---------------|"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50,
            "text": "| Patient ID | Case number shown in Unity (e.g. on drill-down screens) |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51,
            "text": "| First / Last Name | Child's name |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52,
            "text": "| Centre | Which centre the child belongs to |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53,
            "text": "| Date of Birth / Age | Demographics |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54,
            "text": "| Status | Whether the case is active |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55,
            "text": "| Diagnosis | Clinical diagnosis (if recorded) |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57,
            "text": "\u003e **Note:** The database uses the word \"Patient\" — in Unity and this dashboard, that means **child**."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61,
            "text": "### 3. AdminUser — Staff"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63,
            "text": "Clinicians, centre admins, managers, and ops users who work in Unity."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65,
            "text": "| Field | What it means |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66,
            "text": "|-------|---------------|"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67,
            "text": "| First / Last Name | Staff member's name |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68,
            "text": "| Email | Login email |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69,
            "text": "| Role | Clinician, Manager, or Centre Admin (see below) |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 70,
            "text": "| Centre(s) | Which centre(s) they are linked to |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71,
            "text": "| Status | Active or inactive account |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72,
            "text": "| Last Login | When they last signed in |"
          }
        ],
        "range": {
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 72
          },
          "startPosition": {}
        },
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\DATA-DICTIONARY.md",
        "signatures": {}
      },
      "score": 0.220786452293396
    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 70,
            "text": "| Centre(s) | Which centre(s) they are linked to |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71,
            "text": "| Status | Active or inactive account |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72,
            "text": "| Last Login | When they last signed in |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 74,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76,
            "text": "### 4. AdminUserRole \u0026 AdminUserCentre — Who does what, where"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78,
            "text": "These are linking tables (not shown directly in the dashboard, but they determine what you see):"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80,
            "text": "| Link | Meaning |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 81,
            "text": "|------|---------|"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82,
            "text": "| User → Role | Whether someone is a Clinician, Manager, or Centre Admin |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 83,
            "text": "| User → Centre | Which centre(s) their activity is attributed to |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 85,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 87,
            "text": "### 5. AllocatePatient — Assessment assignments"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 89,
            "text": "When a manager assigns an assessment to a clinician for a child, a row is created here. **This is the core \"work item\" clinicians carry.**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 91,
            "text": "| Field | What it means |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 92,
            "text": "|-------|---------------|"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93,
            "text": "| Child | Which patient this assessment is for |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 94,
            "text": "| Clinician | Who is responsible |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 95,
            "text": "| Assessment | Type: **SPM**, **DP3**, **REELS**, or **ISAA** |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 96,
            "text": "| Status | Where the assessment is in the workflow (see statuses below) |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 97,
            "text": "| Assigned date | When the assessment was assigned |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 98,
            "text": "| Result generated? | Whether scoring is complete |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 100,
            "text": "One child can have **multiple assessments** (e.g. SPM + DP3). That is why \"Assessments\" on the overview can be higher than \"Cases\"."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 102,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 104,
            "text": "### 6. PatientAuditLog — Activity events (most important)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 106,
            "text": "Every meaningful action in Unity is logged here. **The dashboard is built almost entirely on this table.**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 108,
            "text": "| Field | What it means |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 109,
            "text": "|-------|---------------|"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 110,
            "text": "| When | Date and time of the action |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 111,
            "text": "| Type | What happened (see event types below) |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 112,
            "text": "| Child | Which case it relates to |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 113,
            "text": "| Staff member | Who performed the action |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 114,
            "text": "| Description | Extra detail (e.g. \"New child case registered\") |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 115,
            "text": "| Centre | Derived from the child's centre |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 117,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 119,
            "text": "### 7. PatientGoalApprovalRequest — Goal approvals"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 121,
            "text": "When a clinician submits therapy goals for manager review, it creates a request here. Used on the **Bottlenecks** tab."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 123,
            "text": "| Field | What it means |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 124,
            "text": "|-------|---------------|"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 125,
            "text": "| Assessment | Which assessment assignment the goals belong to |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 126,
            "text": "| Goal status | Pending, Approved, or Rejected |"
          }
        ],
        "range": {
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 126
          },
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 69
          }
        },
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\DATA-DICTIONARY.md",
        "signatures": {}
      },
      "score": 0.21796199679374695

          {

            "text": "  'incomplete-assessments': queryIncompleteAssessments,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 553,
            "text": "  'all-actions': queryAllActions,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 554,
            "text": "  'slow-onboarding': querySlowOnboarding,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 555,
            "text": "  'slow-goal-approval': querySlowGoalApproval,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 556,
            "text": "  'status-changes': (ctx) =\u003e queryAuditEvents(ctx, 'CaseStatusChanged', 'Status change'),"
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 558,
            "text": "  'funnel-registered': (ctx) =\u003e queryFunnelStage(ctx, 'CaseRegistered', 'Registered'),"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 559,
            "text": "  'funnel-assigned': (ctx) =\u003e queryFunnelStage(ctx, 'CaseAssigned', 'Assigned'),"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 560,
            "text": "  'funnel-results': (ctx) =\u003e queryFunnelStage(ctx, 'ReportPDFGenerated', 'Result generated'),"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 561,
            "text": "  'funnel-goals-approved': queryFunnelGoalsApproved,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 562,
            "text": "  'weekly-onboarding': queryWeeklyOnboarding,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 563,
            "text": "  'weekly-goal-approval': queryWeeklyGoalApproval,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 564,
            "text": "  'centre-severity': queryCentreSeverity,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 565,
            "text": "};"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 566
          },

            "text": "/**"

      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "async (req, res, next) =\u003e {"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33,
            "text": "const ;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35,
            "text": "    const result = await pool.request()"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36,
            "text": "      .input('centreId', sql.BigInt, centreId)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37,
            "text": "      .input('dateFrom', sql.DateTimeOffset, dateFrom)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38,
            "text": "      .input('dateTo',   sql.DateTimeOffset, dateTo)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39,
            "text": "      .query(&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40,
            "text": "        SELECT"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41,
            "text": "          au.Id,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42,
            "text": "          au.FirstName,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43,
            "text": "          au.LastName,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44,
            "text": "          au.Email,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45,
            "text": "          au.LastLoginDateTimeUtc,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46,
            "text": "          c.Id         AS centreId,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47,
            "text": "          c.CentreName,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48,
            "text": "          SUM(CASE WHEN p.Id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalAuditActions,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49,
            "text": "          ISNULL(rs.resultsGenerated, 0) AS resultsGenerated,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50,
            "text": "          ISNULL(cs.activeCaseload, 0)   AS activeCaseload,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51,
            "text": "          MAX(CASE WHEN p.Id IS NOT NULL THEN pal.CreatedDateTime END) AS lastActivityDate"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52,
            "text": "        FROM AdminUser au"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53,
            "text": "        JOIN AdminUserRole aur ON aur.UserId = au.Id"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54,
            "text": "        JOIN AdminRole ar      ON ar.Id = aur.RoleId AND ar.Name = 'Clinician'"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55,
            "text": "        JOIN AdminUserCentre auc ON auc.AdminUserId = au.Id"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56,
            "text": "        JOIN Centre c            ON c.Id = auc.CentreId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57,
            "text": "        LEFT JOIN PatientAuditLog pal ON pal.AdminUserId = au.Id"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58,
            "text": "          AND ${dateFilterPal}"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59,
            "text": "        LEFT JOIN Patient p ON p.Id = pal.PatientId AND p.CentreId = c.Id"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60,
            "text": "        LEFT JOIN ("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61,
            "text": "          SELECT"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62,
            "text": "            ap.ClinicianUserId,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63,
            "text": "            pt.CentreId,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64,
            "text": "            COUNT(DISTINCT pal2.Id) AS resultsGenerated"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65,
            "text": "          FROM PatientAuditLog pal2"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66,
            "text": "          JOIN AllocatePatient ap ON ap.PatientId = pal2.PatientId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67,
            "text": "          JOIN Patient pt         ON pt.Id = pal2.PatientId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68,
            "text": "          JOIN Centre rc          ON rc.Id = pt.CentreId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69,
            "text": "          WHERE pal2.Type IN ('ReportPDFGenerated', 'AssessmentResultGenerated')"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 70,
            "text": "            AND ${dateFilterRes}"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71,
            "text": "            AND ${buildCentreExclusion('rc')}"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72,
            "text": "          GROUP BY ap.ClinicianUserId, pt.CentreId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73,
            "text": "        ) rs ON rs.ClinicianUserId = au.Id AND rs.CentreId = c.Id"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 74,
            "text": "        LEFT JOIN ("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75,
            "text": "          SELECT"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76,
            "text": "            ap.ClinicianUserId,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77,
            "text": "            pt.CentreId,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78,
            "text": "            COUNT(*) AS activeCaseload"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 79,
            "text": "          FROM AllocatePatient ap"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80,
            "text": "          JOIN Patient pt ON pt.Id = ap.PatientId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 81,
            "text": "          JOIN Centre cc ON cc.Id = pt.CentreId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82,
            "text": "          WHERE ap.Status IN ('NotStarted', 'InProgress', 'OnHold')"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 83,
            "text": "            AND "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 96,
            "text": ";"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 116,
            "text": "}"
          }
        ],

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 590,
            "text": "async function buildSummaryQuery(pool, role, ctx) {"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 591,
            "text": "  const { userId, centreId, dateFrom, dateTo, centreExclusion, dateFilterPal, cpf, cpfPt } = ctx;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 592
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 593,
            "text": "  if (role === 'clinician') {"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 594,
            "text": "    return bindCommon(pool.request(), { userId, centreId, dateFrom, dateTo }).query(&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 595,
            "text": "      SELECT"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 596,
            "text": "        ISNULL(rs.resultsGenerated, 0) AS resultsGenerated,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 597,
            "text": "        ISNULL(cs.activeCaseload, 0)   AS activeCaseload,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 598,
            "text": "        ISNULL(act.totalAuditActions, 0) AS totalAuditActions,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 599,
            "text": "        ISNULL(act.activeDays, 0) AS activeDays,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 600,
            "text": "        tat.avgTimeToResultHours,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 601,
            "text": "        ISNULL(stuck.stuckCases, 0) AS stuckCases"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 602,
            "text": "      FROM AdminUser au"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 603,
            "text": "      OUTER APPLY ("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 604,
            "text": "        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pal2.Id) AS resultsGenerated"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 605,
            "text": "        FROM PatientAuditLog pal2"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 606,
            "text": "        JOIN AllocatePatient ap ON ap.PatientId = pal2.PatientId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 607,
            "text": "        JOIN Patient pt         ON pt.Id = pal2.PatientId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 608,
            "text": "        JOIN Centre rc          ON rc.Id = pt.CentreId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 609,

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 169,
            "text": "The dashboard treats **NotStarted + InProgress + OnHold** as the clinician's **active caseload**. A case with no result after 14 days is flagged as **stuck**."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 171,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 173,
            "text": "## Goal approval statuses"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 175,
            "text": "| Status | Meaning |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 176,
            "text": "|--------|---------|"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 177,
            "text": "| **Pending** | Waiting for manager review — blocks clinician progress |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 178,
            "text": "| **Approved** | Manager signed off — goal is active |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 179,
            "text": "| **Rejected** | Manager declined — clinician must revise |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 181,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 182
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 183,
            "text": "## Staff roles"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 184
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 185,
            "text": "| Role | Primary responsibility in the workflow |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 186,
            "text": "|------|----------------------------------------|"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 187,
            "text": "| **Centre Admin** | Registers new children, routes cases to clinical team |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 188,
            "text": "| **Manager** | Assigns assessments to clinicians, approves goals, handles transfers |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 189,
            "text": "| **Clinician** | Completes assessments, generates results, submits goals |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 190
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 191,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 192
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 193,
            "text": "## How dashboard tabs map to data"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 194
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 195,
            "text": "| Dashboard tab | Main data sources |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 196,
            "text": "|---------------|-------------------|"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 197,
            "text": "| **Overview** | Activity log (cases, assessments, results) + Centre |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 198,
            "text": "| **Bottlenecks** | Activity log (timings) + Goal approvals + Assessment statuses |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 199,
            "text": "| **Clinicians / Managers / Centre Admins** | Staff records + Activity log + Assessment assignments |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 200,
            "text": "| **Monitoring** | Activity log (today's actions) + Staff login events |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 201,
            "text": "| **User profile** | All of the above, filtered to one person |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 203,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 205,
            "text": "## What this guide does not cover"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 207,
            "text": "Unity stores much more data that is **not relevant to the ops dashboard**:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 209,
            "text": "- Individual assessment answers and scoring tables (DP3, ISAA, REELS, SPM detail)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 210,
            "text": "- Family Service Plan goals, interventions, and tools"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 211,
            "text": "- Parent/guardian accounts"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 212,
            "text": "- Content library (videos, games, downloadable files)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 213,
            "text": "- CMS admin accounts"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 214,
            "text": "- Password, security, and system internals"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 216,
            "text": "Those exist for clinical and content workflows inside Unity itself. Technical teams can refer to &#96;schema-dump.txt&#96; for the complete database schema (103 tables)."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 217
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 218,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 219
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 220,
            "text": "## Quick glossary"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 221
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 222,
            "text": "| Term | Meaning |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 223,
            "text": "|------|---------|"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 224,
            "text": "| Case | A child enrolled at a centre |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 225,
            "text": "| Assessment | A specific evaluation assigned to a clinician (SPM, DP3, etc.) |"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 226,
            "text": "| Result | Completed scoring / generated report for an assessment |"
          }
        ],
        "range": {
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 226
          },
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 167
          }
        },
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\DATA-DICTIONARY.md",
        "signatures": {}
      },
      "score": 0.20785419642925262
    },

          {
            "lineNumber": 53,
            "text": "    ] = await "
          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 138,
            "text": "&#96;),"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 140,
            "text": "      // Q4: slow / overdue assessments — pending more than 14 days"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 141,
            "text": "      bindAll(pool.request()).query(&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 142,
            "text": "        SELECT TOP 500"

          {
            "lineNumber": 143,
            "text": "          ap.Id             AS allocatePatientId,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 144,
            "text": "          ap.PatientId      AS patientId,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 145,
            "text": "          ap.Assessment     AS assessmentType,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 146,
            "text": "          ISNULL(au.FirstName + ' ' + au.LastName, 'Unassigned') AS clinicianName,"

          {
            "lineNumber": 147,
            "text": "          c.CentreName      AS centreName,"

          {
            "lineNumber": 148,
            "text": "          ap.CreatedDateTimeUtc AS assignedDate,"

          {
            "lineNumber": 149,
            "text": "          DATEDIFF(day, ap.CreatedDateTimeUtc, SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()) AS daysPending"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 150,
            "text": "        FROM AllocatePatient ap"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 151,
            "text": "        JOIN Patient pt   ON pt.Id = ap.PatientId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 152,
            "text": "        JOIN Centre c     ON c.Id  = pt.CentreId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 153,
            "text": "        LEFT JOIN AdminUser au ON au.Id = ap.ClinicianUserId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 154,
            "text": "        WHERE ap.IsResultGenerate = 0"

          {
            "lineNumber": 155,
            "text": "          AND ap.Assessment IN ('SPM','DP3','REELS','ISAA')"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 156,
            "text": "          AND DATEDIFF(day, ap.CreatedDateTimeUtc, SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()) \u003e 14"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 157,
            "text": "          AND ${centreFilter}"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 158,
            "text": "          AND ${centreExclusion}"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 159,
            "text": "        ORDER BY daysPending DESC"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 160,
            "text": "      &#96;),"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 161,
            "text": "    ]);"
          },

            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 163,
            "text": "    // ── Shape byType (fill in zeros for any type with no rows) ───────────────"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 164,
            "text": "    const typeMap = new Map();"

          {

            "text": "    for (const t of ASSESSMENT_TYPES) {"

            "text": "      typeMap.set(t, {"

          {

            "text": "        type: t,"

          {
            "lineNumber": 168,
            "text": "        total: 0,"
          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 170,
            "text": "        pending: 0,"

          {
            "lineNumber": 171,

            "text": "        goalApprovalPending: 0,"

            "text": "      });"

            "text": "    }"

            "lineNumber": 176,
            "text": "    for (const row of byTypeResult.recordset) {"

            "text": "      const t = row.type;"

            "text": "      if (!ASSESSMENT_TYPES.includes(t)) continue;"

            "text": "}"

            "text": "      // Q1: per-assessment-type summary"

            "text": "          COUNT(*)                                                             AS total,"

            "lineNumber": 60,
            "text": "          SUM(CASE WHEN ap.IsResultGenerate = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)            AS completed,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61,
            "text": "          SUM(CASE WHEN ap.IsResultGenerate = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)            AS pending,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62,
            "text": "          AVG("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63,

          {

            "text": "              THEN CAST(DATEDIFF(day, ap.CreatedDateTimeUtc, ap.UpdatedDateTimeUtc) AS FLOAT)"

          {

            "text": "              THEN 1 ELSE 0"

            "text": "        LEFT JOIN Centre c   ON c.Id  = pt.CentreId"

          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 161,
            "text": "async function queryClinicianStuck(ctx) {"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 162,
            "text": "  const { bindAll, centreExclusion, patientNameExpr, clinicianFilter } = ctx;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 163,
            "text": "  const pool = await poolPromise;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 164,
            "text": "  const result = await bindAll(pool.request()).query(&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 165,
            "text": "    SELECT TOP (${MAX_ITEMS})"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 166,
            "text": "      'Stuck case' AS category,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 167,
            "text": "      pt.Id AS patientId,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 168,
            "text": "      pt.PatientID AS patientCode,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 169,
            "text": "      ${patientNameExpr} AS patientName,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 170,
            "text": "      c.Id AS centreId,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 171,
            "text": "      c.CentreName AS centreName,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 172,
            "text": "      ap.CreatedDateTimeUtc AS eventAt,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 173,
            "text": "      CAST(DATEDIFF(minute, ap.CreatedDateTimeUtc, SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()) AS FLOAT) / 60.0 AS waitingHours,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 174,
            "text": "      ap.Status AS status,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 175,
            "text": "      'Assigned \u003e14d with no result generated' AS detail"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 176,
            "text": "    FROM AllocatePatient ap"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 177,
            "text": "    JOIN Patient pt ON pt.Id = ap.PatientId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 178,
            "text": "    JOIN Centre c ON c.Id = pt.CentreId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 179,
            "text": "    WHERE ap.Status IN ('NotStarted', 'InProgress', 'OnHold')"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 180,
            "text": "      AND ap.CreatedDateTimeUtc \u003c DATEADD(day, -14, SYSDATETIMEOFFSET())"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 181,
            "text": "      AND NOT EXISTS ("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 182,
            "text": "        SELECT 1 FROM PatientAuditLog pal3"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 183,
            "text": "        WHERE pal3.PatientId = ap.PatientId"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 184,
            "text": "          AND pal3.Type IN ('ReportPDFGenerated', 'AssessmentResultGenerated')"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 185,
            "text": "      )"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 186,
            "text": "      AND (@centreId IS NULL OR c.Id = @centreId)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 187,
            "text": "      AND ${centreExclusion}"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 188,
            "text": "      AND ${clinicianFilter}"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 189,
            "text": "    ORDER BY ap.CreatedDateTimeUtc ASC"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 190,
            "text": "  &#96;);"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 191,
            "text": "  return result.recordset.map(mapPatientRow);"
          },
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 192,
            "text": "}"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 193
          },

_**Agent (composer-2.5)**_

Here is an audit of everywhere the clinical pipeline is modeled incorrectly today — merged result steps, missing manager/goal stages, technical labels leaking to staff, and case-level counting where assessment-level counts are needed.

## What the pipeline should be

| Step | Plain-language label | Event / source | Owner |
|------|---------------------|----------------|-------|
| 1 | Case registered | `CaseRegistered` | Ops / manager |
| 2 | Assessment assigned | `CaseAssigned` | Manager |
| 3 | **Assessment scored** | `AssessmentResultGenerated` | Clinician |
| 4 | **Report PDF generated** | `ReportPDFGenerated` | Clinician |
| 5 | **Manager review after PDF** | TBD (likely manager-side report event) | Manager |
| 6 | **Goals added** | `GoalAdded` | Clinician |
| 7 | **Goals approved** | `PatientGoalApprovalRequestGoal` → Approved | Manager |

Today most of the app collapses steps 3–4 into one “Results” step and skips 5–6 entirely in funnels.

---

## 1. Funnel / pipeline visuals (need step split + new stages)

| Location | Current problem |
|----------|-----------------|
| `frontend/components/clinicians/ClinicianChart.tsx` — **Clinical Pipeline** card | 3 steps only: Caseload → Active → **Results** (one merged step). No scored / PDF / manager / goals. |
| `frontend/lib/roleStats.ts` — `clinicianFunnel()` | Aggregates `resultsGenerated` into single `results` number. |
| `frontend/components/overview/EventTypeChart.tsx` — **Care Pathway Throughput** | Cases → Assessments → **Results** (single step). |
| `frontend/components/bottlenecks/BottleneckFunnel.tsx` — **Pipeline SLA Funnel** | Registered → Assigned → **Results** → Goals OK. Missing scored, PDF, manager task, goals added. |
| `frontend/components/managers/ManagerChart.tsx` — manager funnel | Stops at Assigned; no post-PDF or goal stages. |

---

## 2. Backend queries feeding those funnels (wrong events / granularity)

| File | Issue |
|------|-------|
| `backend/routes/bottlenecks.js` Q8 | Funnel `results` = **`ReportPDFGenerated` only**; ignores `AssessmentResultGenerated`. No PDF vs scored split; no goal-added stage. |
| `backend/routes/overview.js` | `totalResults` and per-centre `results` = **`ReportPDFGenerated` only** (undercounts vs clinician tab). |
| `backend/routes/clinicians.js` | `resultsGenerated` = **`ReportPDFGenerated` + `AssessmentResultGenerated` merged** into one number; joined on `PatientId`, not per assessment (`AllocatePatientId`). |
| `backend/routes/users.js` — `buildSummaryQuery()` (clinician profile) | Same merged result count; `avgTimeToResultHours` and stuck-case logic grouped by **patient**, not assessment. |
| `backend/routes/role.js` | Stuck-case check uses patient-level `NOT EXISTS` for either result type — misses per-assessment state. |

**Cross-tab inconsistency:** Overview counts PDF only (~115); Clinicians tab counts PDF + scored (~636). Same label, different math.

---

## 3. KPI cards and completion percentages (wrong denominator + merged step)

| Location | Issue |
|----------|-------|
| `frontend/components/overview/MetricCards.tsx` | **Results Generated** + `% pipeline completion` = `totalResults ÷ totalCases` — should be assessment-level, and should split scored vs PDF. |
| `frontend/components/overview/CentreTable.tsx` | **Results** column + **Completion** = `results ÷ cases` — wrong when a case has multiple assessments. |
| `frontend/components/overview/ActivityChart.tsx` | Bar chart **Results** series from same backend field. |
| `frontend/components/clinicians/ClinicianChart.tsx` | Top **Results** KPI + yield % use merged `resultsGenerated`. |
| `frontend/components/clinicians/ClinicianTable.tsx` | **Results** column, yield badge, sort — all merged count. |
| `frontend/components/users/UserKpiCards.tsx` | Clinician profile **Results**, **Yield**, **Avg Time to Result** — merged / patient-level. |
| `frontend/components/bottlenecks/BottleneckCards.tsx` | **Assessment Completion Rate** uses `IsResultGenerate` (single boolean) — no scored-vs-PDF split. |
| `frontend/lib/kpiDefinitions.ts` | `RESULTS_GENERATED`, `CLINICIAN_RESULTS`, `ASSESSMENT_COMPLETION` describe one combined “result” concept. |

---

## 4. Drill-down panels (technical labels + case-level grouping)

| Location | Issue |
|----------|-------|
| `backend/routes/bottleneckDrillDown.js` | `funnel-results` → `queryFunnelStage(..., 'ReportPDFGenerated', ...)` only; **`GROUP BY pt.Id`** — one row per case even with multiple assessments. Sets `status` to raw `'ReportPDFGenerated'`. |
| `backend/routes/roleDrillDown.js` — `queryClinicianResults()` | Merges both types; **`GROUP BY pt.Id, pal.Type`** — still case-level; exposes `pal.Type AS status` (`AssessmentResultGenerated`, `ReportPDFGenerated`). |
| `frontend/components/shared/RoleDrillDownPanel.tsx` | Renders `item.status` raw from backend. |
| `frontend/components/bottlenecks/BottleneckDrillDownPanel.tsx` | Same — shows camelCase event names to staff. |
| `frontend/lib/bottleneckDrillDown.ts` | Only `funnel-results` drill type — no separate scored / PDF / goals-added drills. |
| `frontend/lib/roleDrillDown.ts` | Only `clinician-results` — same gap. |
| `frontend/lib/exportDrillDownCsv.ts` | Exports raw `status` column. |

---

## 5. Assessments tab (assessment-aware but still one “completed” state)

| Location | Issue |
|----------|-------|
| `backend/routes/assessments.js` | Uses `IsResultGenerate = 1` as **completed** — does not distinguish scored vs PDF vs manager sign-off. |
| `frontend/components/assessments/AssessmentTypeCards.tsx` | Pending / completed / goal-approval metrics — no pipeline step breakdown. |
| `frontend/components/assessments/AssessmentClinicianMatrix.tsx` | “assigned / results generated” — merged result concept. |

These are closer to the right granularity (`AllocatePatient`) but still treat completion as one step.

---

## 6. Goal pipeline (partial — approval exists, addition missing)

| Location | What exists | What’s missing |
|----------|-------------|----------------|
| `BottleneckFunnel.tsx` | **Goals OK** (= approved) | **Goals added** step before approval |
| `backend/routes/bottlenecks.js` Q9 | Counts approved goals | No `GoalAdded` count for funnel |
| `backend/routes/bottleneckDrillDown.js` | `funnel-goals-approved`, pending/slow goal queries | No goal-addition drill stage |
| Manager profile (`users.js`) | Pending + completed goal approvals | No “goals submitted” funnel step |

Goal **approval** is partially modeled; goal **addition** is not a funnel stage anywhere.

---

## 7. Documentation and types (still describe merged model)

| Location | Issue |
|----------|-------|
| `DATA-DICTIONARY.md` | Lines 139–140 treat `ReportPDFGenerated` and `AssessmentResultGenerated` as **“same intent”** — contradicts the desired two-step model. |
| `frontend/lib/types.ts` — `BottleneckFunnel` | Single `results` field — schema can’t represent split pipeline without extending. |
| `generate-data-dictionary.js` | Auto-generated docs will mirror the same merged definitions. |

---

## 8. Minor UI — technical event names shown to staff

| Location | Issue |
|----------|-------|
| `frontend/components/users/RecentActionsTable.tsx` | `formatType()` splits camelCase → still reads like **“Report P D F Generated”** |
| `frontend/components/users/UserActionBreakdown.tsx` | Chart labels from raw audit `type` with same split |

These need a central **event label map** (plain English), not regex splitting.

---

## Root causes to fix everywhere

1. **One “Results” bucket** instead of **Scored** + **PDF report** as separate clinician steps.
2. **No manager post-PDF step** and **no goal-addition step** in any funnel.
3. **Case/patient counting** (`PatientId`, `GROUP BY pt.Id`) where **assessment counting** (`AllocatePatientId` / `AllocatePatient`) is required — especially when one child has SPM + DP3 + REELS at different pipeline stages.
4. **Raw `pal.Type` in drill-down `status`** — staff see internal event names.
5. **Inconsistent backend definitions** — overview = PDF only; clinicians = PDF + scored merged.

---

## Suggested fix order (when you implement)

1. Add shared **`lib/auditEventLabels.ts`** (backend + frontend) — map every event to plain English; never expose raw types in UI.
2. Extend **`BottleneckFunnel` / API responses** with separate fields: `scored`, `reportPdf`, `managerReviewed`, `goalsAdded`, `goalsApproved`.
3. Rewrite funnel SQL to count **`AllocatePatientId`** (or distinct assessment assignments), not `PatientId`.
4. Update the six funnel/chart components first, then KPI cards, then drill-downs and types/docs.

The **Clinical Pipeline** card on the Clinicians tab is the most visible instance, but the same structural gap appears in **Overview throughput**, **Bottlenecks SLA funnel**, **centre breakdown tables/charts**, **clinician tables/KPIs**, **user profiles**, **drill-down panels**, and **assessments completion** logic.

If you want, I can implement this as a coordinated change starting with a shared pipeline definition module and then updating each location in the table above.

---

_**User**_

sure

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
The SQL query was updated to use the AllocatePatientId join and separate the scoring and reportPdf counts.

COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pal2.Type = 'AssessmentResultGenerated' THEN pal2.AllocatePatientId END) AS scoringComplete,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pal2.Type = 'ReportPDFGenerated' THEN pal2.AllocatePatientId END) AS reportPdfCreated
FROM PatientAuditLog pal2
JOIN AllocatePatient ap ON ap.Id = pal2.AllocatePatientId
WHERE pal2.Type IN ('ReportPDFGenerated', 'AssessmentResultGenerated')
AND pal2.AllocatePatientId IS NOT NULL

The resultsGenerated field now maps to reportPdfCreated for backward compatibility, or both fields may be used.

The roleDrillDown queryClinicianResults and queryClinicianStuck have been updated accordingly.</details></think>

_**Agent (composer-2.5)**_

Implemented the clinical pipeline fix across the dashboard. Here is what changed:

## Pipeline model (assessment-level, plain English)

All funnels now use these steps, counting **distinct assessments** (`AllocatePatientId`), not cases:

| Step | Label | Source |
|------|--------|--------|
| 1 | Cases registered | `CaseRegistered` (case-level) |
| 2 | Assessments assigned | `CaseAssigned` |
| 3 | Scoring complete | `AssessmentResultGenerated` |
| 4 | Report PDF created | `ReportPDFGenerated` |
| 5 | Report shared | `AllocatePatientReport` (manager) |
| 6 | Goals added | `PatientGoalApprovalRequestGoal` created |
| 7 | Goals approved | Goals with status Approved |

## Where it was applied

**Backend**
- `backend/lib/clinicalPipelineQueries.js` — shared funnel SQL + `mapPipelineRow()`
- `backend/lib/auditEventLabels.js` — plain-English event labels
- `backend/routes/overview.js` — `pipeline` object, assessment-level centre breakdown
- `backend/routes/bottlenecks.js` — 7-step funnel via shared query
- `backend/routes/bottleneckDrillDown.js` — new drill types per stage, assessment-level rows
- `backend/routes/clinicians.js`, `users.js`, `role.js` — assessment-level counts; stuck cases check per `AllocatePatientId`

**Frontend**
- **Clinicians tab** — Clinical Pipeline card (already wired; KPI now shows “Report PDFs” with scoring sub-count)
- **Overview tab** — `EventTypeChart` rebuilt as 7-step funnel; `MetricCards` uses assessments as completion denominator
- **Bottlenecks tab** — `BottleneckFunnel` expanded to all 7 steps with drill-down
- **Centre table** — completion = results ÷ **assessments** (not cases)
- **User profile** — audit types show plain English via `auditEventLabels.ts`
- **Types/KPIs/docs** — updated in `types.ts`, `kpiDefinitions.ts`, `DATA-DICTIONARY.md`

## Key behaviour fixes

1. **No more merged “Results”** — scoring and PDF are separate steps everywhere in funnels.
2. **Multi-assessment cases** — SPM + DP3 on one child counts as 2 at each stage.
3. **No camelCase in UI** — drill-downs use labels like “Scoring complete”, “PDF created”; user action tables use the label map.
4. **Consistent counting** — overview, bottlenecks, and clinicians tab all use the same `clinicalPipelineQueries` logic (overview/clinicians were previously inconsistent).

Restart the backend if it is already running so the new routes load. If you want next, I can add overview funnel drill-down clicks (Overview throughput is display-only today; Bottlenecks and Clinicians tabs already drill down per stage).

---

_**User**_

assignment is done by either manager or admin so update that. when we click on view details it dowsnt show who actioned it

---

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
I'll create a shared SQL helper module for pipeline detail expressions or add to clinicalPipelineQueries.js. It's better to add to roleDrillDown's buildFilterContext as separate expressions.

The code defines several SQL expression functions for generating formatted strings for pipeline audit details, including staff names and assessment information. These expressions concatenate various fields while handling null values and formatting whitespace. The expressions are designed to work with aliases for different tables like assessment providers and clinicians.

The staff name expression combines first and last names with proper null handling. The pipeline audit detail expression includes assessment type, clinician name, and actor name. The goal added detail expression includes assessment type, clinician name, and submitted by information. The goal approved detail expression also includes assessment type and clinician name.

The pipeline audit detail expression includes assessment type, clinician name, and actor name. The goal added detail expression includes assessment type, clinician name, and submitted by information. The goal approved detail expression includes assessment type and clinician name.

For queryPipelineAuditStage, left joins are used with AdminUser tables for clinician and actor. For CaseAssigned, the "By" field represents the assigner (manager or admin) which corresponds to pal.AdminUserId.

For CaseRegistered in funnel drill-down, add an actor join and update GROUP BY to include actor.FirstName and actor.LastName when using actor in detail.

When using MIN(pal.CreatedDateTime) with GROUP BY ap.Id and multiple audit events for the same assessment and type, different actors may exist. To handle this, either pick the actor from the MIN event or use MAX. For simplicity, use MIN(pal.CreatedDateTime) and include actor in GROUP BY from the same row, though this requires a subquery or STRING_AGG for GROUP BY ap.Id with MIN timestamp and actor name.

A simpler approach is to avoid GROUP BY actor and instead use a subquery or MAX(concat). In SQL Server:

To handle actor names in audit logs, a subquery can fetch the first actor by earliest timestamp, or use ROW_NUMBER for cleaner drill-down results. Alternatively, adding actor to GROUP BY may split rows if multiple users log events for the same assessment, which is unlikely for the same type on the same assessment.

For CaseAssigned, use a subquery to safely retrieve the actor name by earliest timestamp, or optionally include clinician details in the audit detail expression. A helper function should be created in a backend library file to handle these SQL expressions consistently.

The function `pipelineActionDetailExpr` generates a formatted string for audit details, incorporating the assessment type, clinician name, and actor name. It uses a subquery to fetch the earliest actor by timestamp, ensuring accurate attribution even when multiple users log events for the same assessment. When a clinician is included, it appends their name along with the assessment type and actor information. If no clinician is assigned, it defaults to "Unassigned". If no actor is found, it defaults to "Unknown". This approach ensures consistent and readable audit trail details.</details></think>

_**Agent (composer-2.5)**_

The drill-down panel was carrying columns that didn’t belong on pipeline views. Here’s what changed.

### What “Wait” was
**Wait** (now **Waiting** when shown) is time stuck on a step — e.g. days since registration without assignment, or hours a goal has been pending. It’s meant for **bottleneck** drill-downs (stuck onboarding, pending goals, incomplete assessments).

For **pipeline** drill-downs (assigned, scoring complete, PDF created, etc.), the backend never sends wait time — those are completed events — so the column was always **—**. That column is now **hidden automatically** when no rows have waiting data.

### Layout changes
- **Wider panel** (`max-w-4xl`) with fixed column widths and top-aligned rows
- **Category hidden** when every row is the same stage (pipeline views — the title already says it)
- **Details parsed into lines** instead of one long string:

  | Assessment | SPM |
  | Clinician  | Jane Doe |
  | Assigned by | John Smith |

- **Waiting** only appears for bottleneck-style lists (stuck cases, pending goals, etc.)
- **Idle** still shows for inactive clinician lists

Refresh and open **View details** on a pipeline step — you should see Patient, Centre, Assessment & staff, and When only. Open stuck onboarding or pending goals on the Bottlenecks tab to see **Waiting** with real values like `3d 4h`.

---

_**User**_

lots of white space that in not necessary

Removing `table-fixed` and using `table-auto` allows columns to size based on content, improving layout flexibility.  
For pipeline views, splitting the detail into structured columnsAssessment, Clinician, and Actioned byprovides better organization than stacked rows.  
An alternative is to use a CSS grid layout with defined column structures for improved control over how detail fields are displayed.

A compact pipeline table layout uses separate columns with auto width, where each column sizes to its content and the "When" column includes `whitespace-nowrap` on the right. _**Agent (composer-2.5)**_

I ran a frontend UX sweep using the **frontend design skill** (Module C — existing app patterns) plus two focused audits: **end-user QoL** and **accessibility/interaction**. Here is a prioritized report for ops, managers, and clinicians.

---

## Executive summary

The dashboard has solid building blocks (drill-down panels, KPI tooltips, funnel drill-downs, plain-English pipeline labels). The biggest gaps are not visual polish — they are **trust and consistency**: duplicate funnels on Overview, conflicting “idle clinician” rules, hidden filters on the landing tab, and patterns that exist on Bottlenecks but not elsewhere (Unity links, clickable flags).

Fixing the top 5–6 items below would materially improve daily use without a redesign.

---

## Critical — fix first (users may distrust the numbers)

| # | Issue | Why it hurts | Where |
|---|--------|--------------|--------|
| 1 | **Two pipeline funnels on Overview** — “Clinical Pipeline” (clickable, starts at Assigned) and “Care Pathway Throughput” (not clickable, includes Registered) | Same workflow, different numbers and only one responds to clicks | `ClinicalPipelineCard`, `EventTypeChart`, `page.tsx` |
| 2 | **Idle clinician definition disagrees** — Overview Action Feed uses **14d + open caseload**; Clinicians KPI uses **7d, no caseload**; drill-down title says “with open cases” but list doesn’t match | Manager sees “5 idle” → clicks → different list | `ActionFeed`, `ClinicianChart`, `roleDrillDown.js` |
| 3 | **Filters hidden on Overview** — centre/date apply but the blue “Filtered · centre #12” banner only shows on other tabs | Users land on Overview and don’t know what scope they’re viewing | `page.tsx` |
| 4 | **Default date = Today only** — first load often looks empty/broken until date is widened | “Is the dashboard broken?” on first visit | `page.tsx`, `TopBar` |
| 5 | **Unity links only in Bottleneck drill-down** — not in Clinicians/Overview pipeline drill-downs | Extra clicks for staff who live in Unity | `RoleDrillDownPanel` vs `BottleneckDrillDownPanel` |
| 6 | **Action Items subtitle missing stuck onboarding** — total includes 3 buckets but subtitle only shows 2 | Headline number doesn’t reconcile | `BottleneckCards.tsx` |
| 7 | **Overview flags (resets/transfers) are static** — same data is clickable on Bottlenecks tab | Missed path from Overview to case lists | `MetricCards` vs `BottleneckFunnel` |

---

## High-impact QoL wins (good ROI, moderate effort)

**Copy & clarity**
- Add **KPI tooltips** to Clinicians tab header cards (definitions already exist in `kpiDefinitions.ts` but aren’t wired).
- Standardize **“Idle clinicians”** wording everywhere (not “Need Follow-up”, “Inactive”, etc.).
- Rename jargon in Clinician table: **Yield → Completion rate**, **Audit Actions → System activity** (with tooltips).
- Show **active filters inside drill-down headers**: “All centres · 1 May – 25 May 2026”.

**Workflow**
- **Full Clinical Pipeline funnel on Clinicians tab** (data is already fetched; only partial KPIs shown today).
- Allow **funnel drill-down at zero count** so empty state confirms “nothing here” instead of dead clicks.
- Make **Overview flags** navigate to Bottlenecks + open the matching drill-down (same as funnel footer).
- **Default date range → Last 7 days** (or This month) instead of Today.

**Tables & mobile**
- Clinician table **★/↓ markers** reflect current sort, not true top/bottom performers — remove or fix with labels.
- Add **min-width + scroll hint** on wide tables (Clinician table has 10 columns).
- **Date picker** on small screens: bottom sheet or stacked layout (current ~536px dropdown can clip).

---

## Accessibility gaps (blocks keyboard / screen reader users)

| Priority | Issue | Fix |
|----------|--------|-----|
| P0 | Drill-down panels: **no focus trap**, focus doesn’t move in/out | Shared `useSlideOverPanel` hook |
| P0 | Sortable headers use `<th onClick>` — **not keyboard operable** | `<button>` inside `<th>` (pattern exists in `MultipleAssessmentCasesPanel`) |
| P1 | **“View details”** relies on `title` only — SR users hear just “42” | `aria-label="Scoring complete: 42. View details"` on all drill triggers |
| P1 | **Nested buttons** — KPI tooltip inside clickable card | Move tooltip outside drill button |
| P1 | TopBar date/centre pickers: missing **`aria-expanded`**, Escape to close, calendar day labels | Combobox + calendar ARIA pass |
| P2 | Small touch targets (14px tooltips, 28px calendar days) | Min 44px hit areas with invisible padding |
| P2 | `text-gray-400` / `text-blue-500` at 10px — **contrast fails AA** | `gray-600`, `blue-700` for labels/links |

---

## Polish (nice-to-have)

- Unify drill-down empty copy (“All clear” vs “Nothing to show”).
- Show “View details” hint once per card, not on every funnel row.
- Export button: icon + “Export 444 rows” + brief confirmation.
- Monitoring tab: banner that it uses **selected day**, not global date range.
- Search pattern from `MultipleAssessmentCasesPanel` → reuse in drill-downs for long lists.

---

## Cross-tab inconsistencies (quick reference)

| Topic | Overview | Bottlenecks | Clinicians |
|-------|----------|-------------|------------|
| Pipeline funnel | Two versions | One (SLA) | Snippets only |
| Operational flags | Static badges | Clickable | — |
| Unity deep links | No | Yes | No |
| KPI tooltips on cards | Yes | Yes | No |
| Filter banner | Hidden | Shown | Shown |
| Idle clinician rule | 14d + caseload | — | 7d, different query |

---

## Recommended fix order

1. Unify **idle clinician** definition + copy (backend + all surfaces).  
2. **Merge/remove duplicate Overview funnel** — one interactive pipeline.  
3. Show **filters on Overview** + centre **name** (not `#12`).  
4. **Default date → Last 7 days**.  
5. **Unity links** in all patient drill-downs + fix Action Items subtitle.  
6. **KPI tooltips + pipeline funnel** on Clinicians tab.  
7. Shared **panel focus trap** + **keyboard sort** + **aria-labels** on drill triggers.

---

If you want to act on this, I’d suggest tackling **1–4 first** in one pass (trust/data clarity), then **5–6** (workflow), then accessibility **7**. Say which bucket you want implemented and I can start — or I can do the full “trust fix” bundle in one go.
